_comment: MASTER MCP inventory for all L9 machine surfaces.
Authority: ~/.cursor-governance/environment/mcp/master.mcp.json
Consumers:
- Cursor: ~/.cursor/mcp.json is a REAL per-machine file rendered from this
inventory by ops/memory/mcp_instantiation.py (make memory-mcp-install).
It is no longer a symlink: the memory package configurator refuses a
symlinked target, and a symlink cannot carry a per-machine entry.
- Claude Desktop: rendered by environment/agents/adapters/claude-desktop/
render_claude_desktop_config.py (make claude-desktop-install).
- Claude Code Web/Mobile: adapter mcp.template.json (env-var refs only).
The canonical memory server (l9-graphite-memory, MemoryService over stdio)
is NEVER authored here. Every renderer hands that one entry to the memory
package's own configurator (`l9-memory client cursor install --path ...`)
against the runtime this checkout is bound to (ops/config/memory-binding.json),
so the same atomic, digest-backed, secret-free entry lands on every surface.
The legacy direct-provider front door (graphiti-memory) is retired
(realignment stage C7) and is dropped from every rendered file.
The capability-broker experiment never shipped. Credential-bearing MCP
servers that pointed at ${L9_CAPABILITY_BROKER_URL}/mcp are removed.
Credentials appear only as ${VAR} references; no value is ever written here.
No-credential MCPs (Playwright, public repos) run locally.
